name: Replace card
description: The caller lost a card and asks for a replacement (debit or credit).

gate.question: Is this a card-replacement call: does the caller want a lost or damaged card replaced?

fields.model_hint: The kind of card the caller wants replaced: debit or credit.

steps.name: Greet and open
steps.description: State the bank name and your own name, then ask how you can help.
steps.example_phrase: Hello, this is Harper Valley National Bank, my name is Jennifer. How can I help you today?
steps.done_when: The agent names the bank and gives their own name, then asks how they can help.

steps.name: Collect card type
steps.description: Get which card the caller wants replaced (debit or credit), by asking or by confirming.
steps.example_phrase: Which card would you like to replace?
steps.done_when: The agent has the card type from the caller: asked for it, or confirmed it after the caller gave it.

steps.name: Log the card replacement
steps.description: Log the task type and the card type.

sub_checks.description: The agent logged the task type 'replace card'
The logged card type matches what the caller asked

steps.done_when: The agent logged the right task type and card type.

steps.name: Confirm replacement
steps.description: Tell the caller the replacement card has been ordered, and which card it is.
steps.example_phrase: I've ordered your replacement debit card.

sub_checks.description: The agent said the replacement card was ordered
The card type said back matches what the caller asked

steps.done_when: The agent says the replacement was ordered and names the right card type.

steps.name: Offer further help
steps.description: Ask whether the caller needs anything else.
steps.example_phrase: Is there anything else I can help you with?
steps.done_when: The agent asks whether the caller needs anything else.

steps.name: Close
steps.description: Thank the caller and end the call.
steps.example_phrase: Thank you for calling, you have a great day.
steps.done_when: The agent thanks the caller or says goodbye before the call ends.
